# apple_webhook (Resource)

Sends an app's App Store Connect events, such as build uploads and version state changes, to a URL. Events are signed with `secret`, which App Store Connect never returns: changes made outside Terraform aren't detected, and after an import the next apply sets it. Test the webhook with `apple_ping_webhook`. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_webhook" "builds" {
  app_id      = data.apple_app.example.id
  name        = "Build notifications"
  url         = "https://hooks.example.com/app-store-connect"
  event_types = ["BUILD_UPLOAD_STATE_UPDATED", "APP_STORE_VERSION_APP_VERSION_STATE_UPDATED"]
  secret      = var.webhook_secret
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `event_types` (Set of String) Events to send: `ALTERNATIVE_DISTRIBUTION_PACKAGE_AVAILABLE_UPDATED`, `ALTERNATIVE_DISTRIBUTION_PACKAGE_VERSION_CREATED`, `ALTERNATIVE_DISTRIBUTION_TERRITORY_AVAILABILITY_UPDATED`, `APP_STORE_VERSION_APP_VERSION_STATE_UPDATED`, `BACKGROUND_ASSET_VERSION_APP_STORE_RELEASE_STATE_UPDATED`, `BACKGROUND_ASSET_VERSION_EXTERNAL_BETA_RELEASE_STATE_UPDATED`, `BACKGROUND_ASSET_VERSION_INTERNAL_BETA_RELEASE_CREATED`, `BACKGROUND_ASSET_VERSION_STATE_UPDATED`, `BETA_FEEDBACK_CRASH_SUBMISSION_CREATED`, `BETA_FEEDBACK_SCREENSHOT_SUBMISSION_CREATED`, `BUILD_BETA_DETAIL_EXTERNAL_BUILD_STATE_UPDATED`, `BUILD_UPLOAD_STATE_UPDATED`.
- `name` (String) Name of the webhook.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret App Store Connect signs events with, so the receiver can verify them.
- `url` (String) HTTPS URL events are sent to.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether events are sent. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the webhook.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_webhook.builds
  identity = {
    id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the webhook.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_webhook.builds 1234567890
```
